questions.q: In 'The Boy and the Filberts', why couldn't the Boy get his hand out of the pitcher?
choices: He took too big a fistful of nuts
The pitcher's neck was too small
His hand was stuck in honey
His mother held the pitcher
questions.evidence: he took such a great fistful that he could not draw his hand out again

questions.q: What is the lesson of 'The Boy and the Filberts'?
choices: Do not attempt too much at once
Always share your nuts with others
Never cry when you cannot have something
Nuts and figs are bad for little boys
questions.evidence: Do not attempt too much at once.

questions.q: In 'Hercules and the Wagoner', what did the Farmer do at first when his wagon got stuck?
choices: Cursed his bad luck and called on Hercules
Put his shoulder to the wheel and pushed hard
Walked to town to find a stronger horse to pull
Unloaded the heavy wagon right there on the road
questions.evidence: curse his bad luck and call loudly on Hercules

questions.q: What lesson did the Farmer learn in 'Hercules and the Wagoner'?
choices: Self help is the best help
Never drive a wagon after the rain
Horses are stronger than people
Always wait for someone to come help
questions.evidence: Self help is the best help.

questions.q: In 'The Kid and the Wolf', why was the Kid brave enough to make faces at the Wolf?
choices: He was safe up on the roof
He was bigger than the Wolf
The herdsman stood beside him
The Wolf was sound asleep
questions.evidence: When you are up there it is the roof that's talking, not you.

questions.q: In 'The Town Mouse and the Country Mouse', what did the Country Mouse serve for lunch?
choices: Wheat stalks, roots, and acorns
Cheese and fancy pastries
Sweetmeats, jellies, and cakes
Bread and butter with milk

questions.q: In 'The Town Mouse and the Country Mouse', what happened just as the Country Mouse was about to eat the pastry?
choices: A Cat mewed and scratched at the door
The Town Mouse grabbed it and ate it first
It slipped off the table and fell on the floor
A servant came in and carried it away
questions.evidence: she heard a Cat mew loudly and scratch at the door

questions.q: In 'The Town Mouse and the Country Mouse', why did the Country Mouse go back home?
choices: She liked a simple life with peace and safety
She did not like the taste of the rich city food
The Town Mouse was rude to her and made fun of her
She missed her family and wanted to see them again
questions.evidence: I prefer my plain food and simple life in the country with the peace and security that go with it
